setup.zh: 水合上了。李家的姑娘回了家；巫婆没有再浮上来。邺城这一年不用再送新娘。
setup.en: The water closes. The Li girl has gone home; the sorceress did not come up again. Ye will send no bride this year.

text.zh: 第二鼎的气息在东边——兖州，济水与河之间。
text.en: The second cauldron's breath lies east — Yan, between the Ji River and the He.

exits.means: rests, ends the chapter, asks what comes next

text.zh: 今日到此为止。兖州的路，开的时候我会告诉你。
text.en: That is all for today. When the road to Yan opens, I will tell you.
